summary: esp32-weather firmware: add rotary encoder page navigation

message.content: Add rotary encoder support to the ESP32 firmware so I can switch between pages: weather, system monitor, stopwatch.

content.text: I added an encoder module using the ESP32 PCNT peripheral for glitch-free counting, with a debounce of 2 ms on the push button. Rotating changes the page index, and each page has a draw function that performs a partial refresh of the e-paper display. The main loop now wakes from light sleep on the encoder GPIO interrupt instead of deep sleep, because deep sleep resets the PCNT counter.

message.content: The stopwatch page flickers on every second.

content.text: I limited the stopwatch page to a partial window covering just the digits and increased the full-refresh interval to every 60 updates. GxEPD2 partial refresh on this panel takes about 300 ms, so updating once per second is near the limit. I also switched the font to a pre-rendered bitmap font to reduce drawing time.
